test_cases.description: Summarize the workspace health and key metrics.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a quick business snapshot for my workspace.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an overview of business health, key counts, and relevant operational signals.

test_cases.description: Show connected LinkedIn identities before posting.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my LinkedIn identities and company pages.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the personal identity and any connected organization identities with posting availability.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a LinkedIn post for our company page about our new service launch.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates or publishes the LinkedIn post using the selected company identity.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create an invoice for Acme Corp and send it to the client.
test_cases.expected_output: Generates the invoice and sends the client-facing invoice flow.

test_cases.user_prompt: Create a contract and send it for signature.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the contract and sends it through the external signing workflow.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated weather requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the weather in Zurich tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside the business workspace domain.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for coding help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write me a Python binary search implementation.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to the business operating system tools.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for restaurant reservations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is outside the supported workflows.
